hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if grep -nE "(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|ya29\.|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{20,}|apiKey:\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"])" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'SECURITY: possible hardcoded secret in '$f; fi; if grep -nE 'console\.log\([^)]*(message|body|content|fields)' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'SECURITY: possible content-bearing log in '$f; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in *authenticate.js|*tokenCipher.js|*validateEnv.js|*/migrations/*) echo 'CAUTION: security-sensitive file — confirm intent before editing '$f;; esac
